articles.title: BJP’s N R Ramesh alleges irregularities in KSWAN, KSDC tenders
articles.description: Bengaluru, Sep 29 (PTI) BJP leader N R Ramesh on Tuesday alleged two scams in the state government’s e-Governance division, including a purported Rs 444-crore irregularity in the KSWAN project. Ramesh, in a press conference, alleged that the Rs 444-crore Karnataka State Wide Area Network 3.0 tender process was manipulated to favour a particular company. […]

articles.title: Yogi Govt To Provide Modern Play Facilities To 17,519 Anganwadi Centers, ₹87.60 Crore Approved
articles.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has approved ₹87.60 crore for installing modern outdoor play equipment at 17,519 Anganwadi Centres and Bal Vatikas across 40 districts. The initiative includes slides, swings, seesaws and other facilities to promote activity-based learning, physical development and child-friendly environments, with procurement through the GeM portal.
